edges: Mullah Mohammed Omar is the leader of the Taliban's self-declared Islamic Emirate of Afghanistan.
The Taliban emerged in Afghanistan to bring order to the country.
Omar oversees the Taliban leadership council and judiciary.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Omar follows a daily work schedule that includes prayers and study.
Taliban militants have continued to battle the U.S.-backed government across Afghanistan.
Years without any video or audio recordings have led to growing speculation about Omar's possible death.
